column3: “Incense altars” is a rare word (perhaps “sun pillars”).
“Held guilty” is rendered “desolate,” following some ancient versions.
“I will leave over” is rendered “I shall leave a remnant.”
“I was crushed” is rendered “how I have been hurt”; some versions read “I crushed.”
“Strike with your hand” is rendered “Clap your hand.”
“The one who is preserved” is rendered “is besieged.”
“Diblah” may be a scribal error for “Riblah”; NASB has “toward Diblah.”
